findings.problem: The trick says the stress moves to the end, but in detective the stress falls on the next-to-last syllable (ti), not the last one (ve), so a learner could stress the wrong syllable.
findings.fix: trick: DETECTIVE is spelled just like the English word, but the stress moves to TEE: deh-tek-TEE-veh.

note: Detective has one form for both genders (el detective for a man, la detective for a woman), so the editor could add that to the grammar or the answer side.
